## Summary
- What changed?
- Why is this needed?

## Scope
- Service: `api`
- Type: `feat | fix | chore | docs | refactor | test | ci`

## Validation
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

- [ ] No secrets committed
